title: Trade Executed Event
description: Schema for EVT:TRADE_EXECUTED event payload describing a single executed trade

side.description: Trade direction: 'buy' for long positions, 'sell' for short positions

price.description: Execution price per unit (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

quantity.description: Executed quantity (positive for buy, negative for sell) (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

ts.description: Timestamp of trade execution in milliseconds

fees.description: Trading fees paid for this trade (optional, defaults to 0) (string-encoded Decimal for precision)

venue.description: Trading venue/exchange where the trade was executed
